correctness.rationale: Acan–Hitczenko binary-run encoding yields degrees r_i+1, remaining ones and D=b+1. Adding one uniformly selected cut yields a uniform refined composition and strictly majorized sorted degrees, implying all-strictly-convex monotonicity. Pair-in-run indicator sums give exact EZ and Cov(D,Z); generating functions yield Var Z; iid geometric renewal-reward CLT gives the stated limiting covariance with controlled censored terminal run. Independent exact rational enumeration through n=9 verifies conditional means, variances, covariances and all cut refinements.
